title: Stop Saying "Very Big"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very big". Say one of these instead:
• Huge: It's huge!
• Enormous: He caught an enormous fish.
• Massive: A massive wave hit the beach.
• The expression: It's the size of a house!

Full lesson: Stop Saying "Very" in English: 30 Words to Use Instead of "Very" (With Pictures)
